candidate_matches.title: Terminal snapshot storage budgets and tombstone expiry
candidate_matches.reason: Defines the bounded local viewport-snapshot baseline needed to characterize current refresh behavior and compare browser-retained versus server-retained ranges. Cross-target risk: changing or removing this stable 0.5.5 contract from wave-1 would be a conflicting update; use only an additive depends_on link, and defer any post-G1 retirement decision.

candidate_matches.title: Split WebSocket handshake and channel isolation
candidate_matches.reason: Direct baseline for split runtime/test drift because it specifies unified, split-shadow, and split handshake behavior with focused test evidence. Cross-target risk: wave-1 must not revise these stable mode semantics or imply their verification is complete; an additive drift-characterization requirement may extend this contract.

candidate_matches.title: Split WebSocket terminal payload routing and failure recovery
candidate_matches.reason: Closest split-path match: it specifies runtime terminal routing, fallback, replay, and repair recovery plus regression coverage. Cross-target risk: a wave-1 drift finding could conflict with this stable implemented contract if recorded as an update; preserve it and add an extends relation for runtime-versus-test characterization and G1 evidence.

candidate_matches.title: Wave 7 frontend runtime resource consumers
candidate_matches.reason: Establishes the current default browser path as bounded and snapshot-restore based, including hidden and visible recovery. Cross-target risk: server-authoritative retained-state migration could later change this stable default; the initial wave-1 envelope must only extend it with refresh characterization and a decision gate, not update or supersede it.

candidate_matches.title: Frame time-budgeted visible output flush with input yield
candidate_matches.reason: Useful as a performance confounder when measuring recovery, but it concerns live visible-output flushing rather than retained-state authority or refresh completeness. Cross-target risk: attaching retained-state benchmark conclusions to this unverified implemented requirement would blur evidence ownership; no relation is recommended in the initial envelope.

candidate_matches.title: Cached UTF-8 byte-length and resource-limit reuse in terminal output handling
candidate_matches.reason: Covers per-output allocation optimization and runtime-config cache invalidation, not split drift, refresh retained range, or G1 selection. Cross-target risk: treating it as retained-state benchmark coverage could incorrectly update or claim evidence for an evolving 0.5.5 requirement; no relation is recommended.

candidate_matches.title: ConPTY input-lag recovery telemetry and soak evidence
candidate_matches.reason: Provides the closest existing benchmark-evidence framework through queue pressure, recovery timing, deterministic redraw tests, and soak evidence. Cross-target risk: wave-1 must not move, complete, or broaden this planned 0.5.5 requirement in place; a retained-state-specific benchmark requirement may additively extend it.

candidate_matches.title: Empty fallback snapshot diagnostics and regression evidence
candidate_matches.reason: Strong match for refresh characterization and recovery convergence evidence, especially local restore, empty fallback, replay timeout, and redacted diagnostics. Cross-target risk: adding authoritative retained-range or browser-refresh criteria directly would update this planned 0.5.5 requirement; create a wave-1 requirement that extends it.

candidate_matches.title: 다중 세션 이벤트 루프 포화 진단 관측 지표
candidate_matches.reason: Its event-loop, CPU, and headless-write metrics can serve as benchmark controls for retained-state recovery cost, but it does not define retained-state evidence itself. Cross-target risk: wave-1 must not redefine its thresholds or claim its verification; use depends_on only if those metrics are actually consumed by the benchmark.

candidate_matches.title: ConPTY transport and recovery Settings contract
candidate_matches.reason: Potential configuration provenance for evidence runs that vary transport and recovery tunables, but it contains no G1 migration-versus-bug-only decision. Cross-target risk: making wave-1 activation contingent on new fields would improperly update a planned 0.5.5 contract; use depends_on only for tunables the benchmark demonstrably consumes.

candidate_matches.title: Frontend recovery write gate and queued input release barrier
candidate_matches.reason: Defines client-side snapshot, repair, replay-tail ordering, and recovery completion behavior relevant to retained-state replay measurements. Cross-target risk: wave-1 must not absorb or modify this planned implementation contract; retained-state characterization may depend_on it only where recovery-write ordering is an explicit benchmark precondition.

candidate_matches.title: Empty fallback snapshot convergence and placeholder suppression
candidate_matches.reason: Closest refresh viewport-only match because AC-1 explicitly uses a valid local viewport snapshot, while the requirement does not promise full browser retained-state restoration. Cross-target risk: adding full retained-range equivalence here would update a planned 0.5.5 contract and conflate fallback convergence with architectural authority; add a wave-1 extends requirement.

candidate_matches.title: Byte-aware replay tail and screen repair overflow recovery
candidate_matches.reason: Relevant server-side baseline for bounded replay ranges, refresh-on-overflow, and payload-boundary preservation. Cross-target risk: a server-authoritative retained-state contract is broader than this planned replay-tail requirement and must not be inserted as its update; an additive wave-1 requirement may extend it if G1 selects migration.

candidate_matches.title: Fallback replay output preservation and degraded snapshot convergence
candidate_matches.reason: Strong server recovery baseline covering ordered output preservation, refresh convergence, bounded replay data, and explicit withheld-data reasons. Cross-target risk: wave-1 must not reinterpret this stable fallback contract as full retained-state authority or mark it verified; add an extends relation for authoritative-range characterization and benchmark evidence.

no_match_reason: The 0.5.5 target has partial baselines but no exact requirement that (1) detects split production-runtime versus test-assumption drift, (2) characterizes browser refresh as viewport-only against an explicit retained range, (3) records retained-state authority benchmark evidence, or (4) gates G1 between architectural migration and confirmed-bug-only activation. Those concerns therefore require additive wave-1 requirements linked only through justified depends_on or extends relations. Existing requirements must not be moved, duplicated, updated, or superseded during this envelope cycle. REL-BGSTAB-005 was explicitly excluded because bounded parallel shutdown termination is unrelated.
